proposals.evidence: Qualified western reflexes of the carváti family: Turner lists Gujarati cāvvũ chew and Marathi ċāvṇẽ chew/bite. Noiri/Dungra sāv- is compared with cāv- in the same survey continuum, allowing local affricate simplification; this is a comparative family assignment, not proof of the exact sound history. Forms with ambiguous auxiliary endings are excluded.
